prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1204; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in League City, in the right lane, waiting to turn.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from the back and my head snapped forward and then back against the seat.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: Yes, but I felt stiff and my lower back was already aching. The other driver seemed shaken but apologized.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or emergency room afterward?

A: I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They told me I had a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some instructions for rest.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries or treatment to your back?

A: I had a minor backache a couple of years ago that cleared up with stretching. Nothing that needed a doctor.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. Sitting for long periods is hard, and I've had to modify how I lift things around the house. I'm following up with my physical therapist twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm trying to get back to normal and I want my claim handled fairly. I'll provide the urgent care records and therapy notes when you request them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
